therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: inhibition of Src-mediated signaling pathways involved in tumor progression and metastasis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with recurrent osteosarcoma localized to the lung

results.effect_size: median PFS 19.4 months (saracatinib) vs 8.6 months (placebo), 95% CI: 0-60 for both arms
biomarker_changes: biomarkers related to activation of Src and Src substrates evaluated but results not reported
results.dose_information: oral agent, specific dose not provided

context.duration: evaluation every 3 months for 1st year, then every 6 months up to 2 years, then yearly up to 5 years
context.investigator_commentary: median overall survival not reached in either group and the curves overlapped
